name: jev-ci-triage
description: Classify every failing CI test as regression, flaky, environment, test-data or unknown. Deterministic signals first, Jev (TypeSafe) only for the ambiguous ones. Never masks, never reruns.
author: Cristian Guerra (@criguex)

scripts.demo:triage: tsx src/cli.ts --results demo/runs/current.json --history demo/runs/history --changed-files demo/scenario/changed-files.txt --config demo/jev-triage.config.json --out report --jev replay
